readme:
# OpenVLA 动作token与分位数还原

## 1. 问题

OpenVLA 动作token与分位数还原：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

复现官方ActionTokenizer的离散约定及动作反归一化；不加载7B模型。边界数组可缩小以便手算，默认论文规模为256个边界、255个中心。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
d=\sum_j\mathbf1[\operatorname{clip}(a,-1,1)\ge e_j],\quad t=V-d,\quad \hat a=(e_i+e_{i+1})/2,\ i=\operatorname{clip}(V-t-1,0,N-2).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `encode_actions(actions: Tensor, edges: Tensor, vocab_size: int) -> Tensor`
- `decode_actions(tokens: Tensor, edges: Tensor, vocab_size: int) -> Tensor`
- `unnormalize_actions(actions: Tensor, q01: Tensor, q99: Tensor, mask: Tensor) -> Tensor`

编码使用末端词表的倒序编号；np.digitize默认right=False使恰在边界上的值进入右侧桶。最大边界会得到最后一个特殊编号，但解码夹到最后中心。反归一化只作用于mask指定的坐标，未指定坐标原样保留。

## 4. 本题约定

actions为任意非空浮点张量，edges为严格递增一维且两端为-1/+1，vocab_size>=边界数。token为int64；解码token必须在[0,V)，超出动作区间的词表token按官方clip映射端点中心。反归一化输入(B,D)，q01/q99为(D,)且q99>q01，mask为(D,)布尔。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09246) — Official action_tokenizer.py digitize / reversed IDs; OpenVLA.predict_action quantile unnormalization
- [Verified source](https://github.com/openvla/openvla/blob/main/prismatic/vla/action_tokenizer.py)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/openvla/openvla/blob/main/prismatic/models/vlas/openvla.py)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

先按公式确定归约轴、有效掩码和梯度路径，再将手算小例与实现逐项比较。测试中的独立预期值不调用参考答案。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Exact edges use the wrong digitize boundary convention.
- Action IDs are not reversed from the vocabulary end.
- Unmasked coordinates are incorrectly converted to physical units.

## 实验范围

复现官方ActionTokenizer的离散约定及动作反归一化；不加载7B模型。边界数组可缩小以便手算，默认论文规模为256个边界、255个中心。

## 可重复实验记录

33个边界、99个输入值组成33组3维动作，测试[-1.2,1.2]范围。量化归一化误差<=1/32，物理误差<=1/16，超过80个编码可经中心值一致回编码；无需训练器。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.readme:
# OpenVLA Action Tokens and Quantile Unnormalization

## 1. Exercise goal

OpenVLA Action Tokens and Quantile Unnormalization: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Reproduce official ActionTokenizer conventions and action unnormalization without a 7B model. Smaller edge arrays make examples inspectable; the official default has 256 edges and 255 centers.

## 2. Core equations

$$
d=\sum_j\mathbf1[\operatorname{clip}(a,-1,1)\ge e_j],\quad t=V-d,\quad \hat a=(e_i+e_{i+1})/2,\ i=\operatorname{clip}(V-t-1,0,N-2).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `encode_actions(actions: Tensor, edges: Tensor, vocab_size: int) -> Tensor`
- `decode_actions(tokens: Tensor, edges: Tensor, vocab_size: int) -> Tensor`
- `unnormalize_actions(actions: Tensor, q01: Tensor, q99: Tensor, mask: Tensor) -> Tensor`

Encoding reverses IDs from the vocabulary end. The official np.digitize right=False convention assigns exact edges to the bin on their right. The maximum edge receives the last code and decoding clips it to the last center. Unnormalization transforms only masked coordinates.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Actions are any nonempty floating tensor; edges is strictly increasing 1-D with endpoints -1/+1, vocab_size>=number of edges. Tokens are int64 in [0,V); non-action vocabulary IDs clip to endpoint centers on decoding. Unnormalization takes (B,D), q01/q99 (D,) with q99>q01, and bool mask (D,).

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09246) — Official action_tokenizer.py digitize / reversed IDs; OpenVLA.predict_action quantile unnormalization
- [Verified source](https://github.com/openvla/openvla/blob/main/prismatic/vla/action_tokenizer.py)
- [Verified source](https://github.com/openvla/openvla/blob/main/prismatic/models/vlas/openvla.py)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.

# OpenVLA: Solution notes

Encoding reverses IDs from the vocabulary end. The official np.digitize right=False convention assigns exact edges to the bin on their right. The maximum edge receives the last code and decoding clips it to the last center. Unnormalization transforms only masked coordinates.

Identify reduction axes, validity masks and gradient paths from the equations before comparing a small hand calculation. Test oracles do not call the reference implementation.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- Exact edges use the wrong digitize boundary convention.
- Action IDs are not reversed from the vocabulary end.
- Unmasked coordinates are incorrectly converted to physical units.

## Experimental scope

Reproduce official ActionTokenizer conventions and action unnormalization without a 7B model. Smaller edge arrays make examples inspectable; the official default has 256 edges and 255 centers.

## Reproducible protocol

33 edges and 99 values form 33 three-dimensional actions spanning [-1.2,1.2]. Normalized quantization error <=1/32, physical error <=1/16, and more than 80 center-decoded codes round-trip identically; no trainer is used.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
